text:
Maya Patel: thinking out loud — we should split the console query surface: keep the renderer-facing projection (materialization/tiling) separate from an authz shim that can be swapped for private/dedicated. Tradeoffs: extra RPC hop vs much simpler RBAC caching.
Liam Chen: +1 to separation. main concern: added latency for hot paths. Do we have numbers on typical panel queries? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sofia Gómez: p99 on panels is currently ~80ms in prod for simple widgets, 180ms for multi-join dashboards. Extra local shim should be like ~5-10ms if colocated.
Rajiv Singh: important VC: cache invalidation. If authz is separate it needs cheap checks against prefix caches. We can't do full user-table scans on every request.
Maya Patel: agree. proposal: authz-shim serves lightweight allowlist checks and signs projection tokens. projections remain cacheable across tenants if token includes view-mask. Example token flow:
```
client -> projection-service (cacheable) -> returns tile + view-mask
client -> authz-shim validates view-mask for user -> signs token
proxy -> accepts signed token and serves tile
```
Liam Chen: signing step is neat. How do we rotate keys? KMS/HSM integration required for Private.
Sofia Gómez: also need fallback for Dedicated when projection-service can't sign (outage). Can we have a graceful degrade: non-signed path but rate-limited?
Rajiv Singh: fallback with strict SLO throttles and strong audit logs. ops-bot: deploy plan template available: https://console/internal/runbooks/authz-shim-cutover
Maya Patel: perf experiment plan: A/B 5% traffic route through shim (colocated), measure p95/p99 and cache hit rates. If delta < 7ms p99 and error delta < 0.1% we proceed.
Liam Chen: +1. I'll sketch the A/B harness and add load test for large tenant with 2000 panels.
Sofia Gómez: also add metric for 'projection-token-regen' to track churn (high churn kills cache). Keep TTLs conservative.
Maya Patel: action items: Liam to add load test, Rajiv to draft invalidation story, Sofia to add telemetry + SLO gates. I'll write short RFC follow-up with diagrams.
Liam Chen: tagging @SRE too — we need to coordinate CD for the shim rollout.
ops-bot: noted: created ticket INF-7892 for rollout coordination. :robot_face:
Rajiv Singh: one more note — for private deployments, allow an 'embedded' mode where authz runs in-process to avoid extra network hop.
Maya Patel: good point. include embedded mode in RFC. ok that's the plan — will sync in design review tomorrow 10am.
